verdict.rationale: A domain registrar could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, such as portfolio or renewal suggestions, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no in-product AI insight or suggestion feature. The official MCP server lets external AI clients like Claude or Cursor act on the account, which is an adjacent integration with an outside AI, not AI-generated insights delivered inside Porkbun itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
